details: The total cryptocurrency market capitalization has retreated to $2.11 trillion, marking a 2% decline in the past 24 hours and returning to mid-summer lows, reflecting a broader downturn in global stocks. Bitcoin (BTC) has fallen below $60,000, experiencing an 8.5% drop this week, while Ethereum (ETH) is trading under $1,750, a 6% weekly decrease.
title: Crypto Market Cap Drops Below $2.11T; BTC Under $60K

details: BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) experienced its largest single-day outflow, totaling $541 million, coinciding with the market debut of Anthropic. This significant withdrawal contributes to a broader trend of $3.5 billion in Bitcoin ETF outflows.
title: BlackRock's IBIT Sees Record $541M Outflow Amid Anthropic Debut

details: Ethereum is under renewed market pressure, with US spot Ethereum ETFs recording $131.2 million in outflows on November 19 and $427.5 million in ETH liquidations over a 24-hour period. This contributes to a 10.17% decline in ETH over the last seven days, further compounded by delays for its "Glamsterdam" upgrade until at least January 2027.
title: Ethereum Faces Renewed Market Pressure and Significant ETF Outflows

details: The U.S. Senate has passed the "Death Bets Act," a new legislation aimed at banning prediction market contracts tied to outcomes such as death and war. This signals increasing regulatory scrutiny on specific segments within the crypto industry.
title: US Senate Passes 'Death Bets Act' Restricting Prediction Markets

details: Hong Kong is moving forward with proposals to subject crypto custodians and financial advisers to new licensing requirements. This initiative aims to enhance regulatory clarity and strengthen investor protection within the region's digital asset sector.
title: Hong Kong Proposes Licensing Rules for Crypto Custodians and Advisers

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is actively seeking industry partners to collaborate on experiments involving tokenized deposits and securities. This move highlights growing institutional interest in exploring blockchain-based solutions for traditional financial instruments.
title: ECB Seeks Partners for Tokenized Deposits and Securities Experiments

details: Bitcoin Core has released versions 30.5 and 31.3 to address a medium-severity vulnerability. The flaw, capable of causing nodes to stall, was identified by Loupe, an AI scanning tool from Spiral, demonstrating ongoing efforts in network security.
title: Bitcoin Core Patches AI-Discovered Node Vulnerability
